CustomField.description: Name of the selling entity, as quoted in the broker email and carried from Lead.Seller_Entity__c at conversion. Deliberately Text, not a lookup — there is no Seller object, and this is a free-text name as stated by the broker, not a reference to a Salesforce record. Per ARCHITECTURE.md §1 rule 9's Text exception.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Carried from the Lead at conversion; null when not stated in the email.
CustomField.label: Seller Entity
